name: LocalizationSceneSetup
src_typeComment: Toolkit > Localization > Set Up In This Scene.  The four steps between "I imported a sheet" and "a label shows French" are: make a GameObject, add a LocalizationManager, find the registry, assign it. None of them is a decision — which is exactly the kind of thing a menu item should do for you. Same reasoning and shape as PlayerCameraRigSetup: not a prefab, because a prefab could not find YOUR registry, and the component is already plug-and-play on its own, so this is convenience rather than a requirement.  Safe to run twice: an existing manager is configured and selected rather than duplicated — which also makes it a usable "did I wire this up?" check on a scene someone else built.
